    # Transpose the 3x3 input to form the motif. Repeat it three times
    # horizontally; the central vertical band is vertically flipped.
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    motif = [[grid[c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(m)]
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        rows = motif[::-1] if tile_r == 1 else motif
        for r in rows:
            out.extend([r[:] for _ in range(3)])
    return out
